exposure.needed: which issuers have their linked Secret updated at runtime (live Secret writes/rotations)

consequence.statement: After upgrading, when an issuer's linked Secret is updated the issuer will retry more quickly instead of being delayed by the previous high back-off timeout; nothing is rejected or fails, only the timing of reconciliation after Secret updates changes.
consequence.remediation: No operator action required; expect issuer reconciliation to happen sooner after a linked Secret is updated than in previous releases.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager 1.17.0, the issuer retries more quickly when its linked Secret is updated, fixing an issue that previously caused a high back-off timeout.

checks.detail: no canonical exposure condition for protocol-behavior behavior-changed
